desc: Ideation: identify the B-bit window and choose exact boolean matrix exponentiation over safe gaps instead of heuristic saturation.
Implement the concise exact B-bit boolean matrix exponentiation program specified in NEXT (state orientation, T rows, OR-AND composition, bad-block shifts, final bit check).

Verify the program on the three samples and edge cases: M=0, B=1, A=B, A=1, zero-length safe gaps, adjacent intervals, bad block length >=B, large N, and a case where a bad block leaves only an old bit before a long safe gap.
